senses.definition: (archaic, rare) A small tilt hammer, worked by the foot.

quotes.text: I hear, with the song that she sings me in lullaby tones, / The noise of the nailshops, the ringing of hammers, the groans / Of deep-heaving bellows, the "oliver's" thud on the die, […]
